MIT’s October22 institutional report attributes the approach/design approvals to NRC; the docket was not independently inspected here. Design/approach approval and September application filing do not establish full site construction or operating permission; undisclosed does not mean nonexistent. Schedule/revenue/$5,000-per-kW later-project cost are targets, not outcomes or electricity prices. The planned Victoria hybrid starts with1GWgas in2030, then up to1.5GWnuclear from2032; neither full2032conversion nor lifecycle zero-carbon is established. Benefits remain expectations. Nuclear failure being only a building-site problem is broad rhetoric, not a demonstrated universal cause. Yard environment, transport limits, gas-phase infrastructure reuse and financing arguments are analysis; no reduced financing cost or completed plant is proven.
